text:
Sasha: Quick thread — we need a tight benchmark narrative for the webinar (latency vs $/token). Goal: one hero claim, 3 supporting charts, and 2 short CTA lines. Keep copy TL;DR for slides.

Maya: Sounds good. My thinking: lead with predictable latency + unit economics. Then show: 1) latency distribution (median/95/99) across models, 2) tokens->$ waterfall (model, batching, quant), 3) SLA impact: fallback costs for degraded tiers. I'll draft hero lines.

Kevin: Data asks from analytics side: can we get slices for the three chart types? Specifically: a) seq=1k median/95/99 latency by model+quant; b) cost per 1k tokens under 3 batching profiles (single-request, batch-optimized, cached); c) throughput (rps) per GPU at steady-state and peak. Also need prompt-mix (50/30/20 long/medium/short).

Lia: Visuals: prefer small multiples for models on the latency chart, stacked bars for the cost waterfall (show token cost, infra, amortized infra), and a micro-annotation for cache savings. Use consistent color palette and a 3-line explainer under each chart.

Sasha: Nice. Timeline: slides ready Tue EOD. Maya — hero + 3 caption lines by Mon noon. Kevin — charts/data CSV + sampling prompts by Mon 3pm. Lia — mockups by Tue AM. I'll stitch and send to review Wed.

Kevin: Copying data export location in case it helps: s3://bench-exports/2026/lat-cost/webinar-slices-2026-03-22.csv (will populate by Mon 2pm). Samples attached in thread.

DataBot: Automated check: CSV schema expected — columns: model, quant, seq_len, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_request, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, batch_profile. If schema mismatch, bot will ping.

Maya: Draft hero options (short):
- Option A: "Predictable latency. Lower unit cost. Better product experience"
- Option B: "Latency you can guarantee. Economics you can measure."
- Option C: "Serve fast. Save on every token."
Which do we like?

Lia: Leaning B for enterprise resonance, C reads punchy for PLG. Maybe use B on slide and C on social blurbs.

Kevin: Quick snippet I'll include for compute calc so folks can reproduce cost numbers:
```
# rough per-1k token cost calc
tokens = 1000
est_seconds_per_1k = 0.8  # example
gpu_hours = est_seconds_per_1k / 3600
gpu_rate = 2.5  # $/gpu-hour
cost = gpu_hours * gpu_rate
print(cost)
```

Sasha: Perfect. Also add an inset showing cache impact: "cache hit -> 30-70% lower unit cost" with a small table. Kevin — can you provide cache vs no-cache rows?

Kevin: Yup, will include cache/no-cache comparisons and a quick AB example (search vs completion workload).

Maya: I'll draft the slide copy + three-sentence webinar intro and a short 1-paragraph blog lead for follow-up. Posting drafts here when done.

Sasha: Awesome — thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. :thumbsup:

Lia: Noted. Will start mockups after we get CSV. :eyes:

DataBot: CSV upload scheduled at 2026-03-22T13:55:00Z.

Kevin: Uploaded sample prompts & CSV preview link: https://internal.redwood/bench/webinar/preview (private).

Maya: Drafts posted: /drive/marketing/webinar-copy/latency-cost-drafts.md — feel free to edit.

Sasha: Closing loop — next check-in Mon 4pm. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
